# Test Requirements Checklist: Typed-text step in the live end-to-end test

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of a test-only change: are the four FRs and the acceptance scenarios complete, unambiguous and measurable enough to write and review one end-to-end check against.
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: Standard. Audience: PR reviewer. Focus: completeness and measurability of the check's assertions; scope boundary of a test-only change. Reviewed 2026-10-07 by the planning agent (autonomous run); each line carries its reason.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the dialog, its text fields and the account under test named rather than described? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Key Entities] — "Invită în echipă", "Nume", "E‑mail", the seeded garage owner.
- [x] CHK002 Are the preconditions of the account (owner of its garage, able to open the dialog) stated as assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — last bullet; context.md Constraints add the team feature flag, moot since the dialog is never submitted.
- [x] CHK003 Is the actor and channel of the live update specified (who sends, from where)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions] — an admin session over the API, the garage account's id, as the sibling checks.
- [x] CHK004 Are the suite tags and external needs (mailbox, seeded data) stated? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases] — `@seeded` only, no mailbox, no data change.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "within 2 seconds" anchored to a start event? [Clarity, Spec §Scenario 1, SC-002] — from the admin's send, the bound the sibling checks use.
- [x] CHK006 Is "no document load" anchored to a baseline moment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Clarification 4] — "since the dashboard opened", counted by the page's load events from then.
- [x] CHK007 Is "still focused" defined as the same field, not any field? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — "the same field is still focused".
- [x] CHK008 Is the typed-text entry mode (fill vs keystrokes) and what of it is asserted (value, focus, caret) fixed? [Clarity, Spec §Clarification 3] — key by key; value and focus asserted, caret not.
- [x] CHK009 Is the end of the check (cancel, submit, close) fixed, given that a dirty form may raise a discard confirm? [Clarity, Spec §Clarification 2, Assumptions] — the context is closed, never cancelled or submitted.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK010 Is "no invitation sent" expressed as something observable from the test, with the request shape named? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, Clarification 1] — no `POST …/garages/:garageId/invites` left the page.
- [x] CHK011 Does SC-003 say how "each assertion would fail on its own" is verified, since web-e2e has no mutation run? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Clarification 5] — by review: four separate expectations.
- [x] CHK012 Is the status line located in a way the spec says works behind a modal? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases] — by status role and text, since the modal hides the page from the accessibility tree.

## Requirement Consistency & Scope

- [x] CHK013 Are the asserted texts in one language consistent with how the dashboard is opened? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Key Entities] — all Romanian, the dashboard opened under `/ro` as the siblings do.
- [x] CHK014 Is the test-only boundary explicit, including what existing checks must stay? [Scope, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases] — no product code, no new dialog; the confirm-dialog and isolation checks stay.
- [x] CHK015 Is the relation to the capability spec stated so the archive can merge it? [Traceability, Spec §Spec Delta] — adds FR-001..004 to `live-updates`; 256-FR-005 unchanged.
- [x] CHK016 ~~Are recovery or retry requirements defined for a live update that never arrives?~~ [Gap] — struck: a test-only change has no recovery path; a missing line is the check failing (SC-001).

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
